name: VANTIX Attestor - Service Recovery - Pre-Import Validated v0.2

parameters.jsCode: const s=$input.first().json; const i=s.input; if(!i.syntheticData) throw new Error('SR_SYNTHETIC_ONLY'); s.runtime.module='SERVICE_RECOVERY'; s.runtime.correlationId=i.runMetadata.correlationId; s.runtime.runId=i.runMetadata.runId; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('CONTEXT_INITIALIZED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json,i=s.input; const req=['schemaVersion','recordType','runMetadata','case','evidence','humanDecision']; const miss=req.filter(k=>i[k]===undefined); if(miss.length) throw new Error('SR_REQUIRED_MISSING:'+miss.join(',')); if(i.recordType!=='SERVICE_RECOVERY_RUN'||i.runMetadata.module!=='SERVICE_RECOVERY') throw new Error('SR_CONTRACT_MISMATCH'); const ids=i.evidence.map(e=>e.evidenceId); if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length) throw new Error('SR_DUPLICATE_EVIDENCE_ID'); if(i.humanDecision.boundCorrelationId!==i.runMetadata.correlationId) throw new Error('SR_DECISION_BINDING_MISMATCH'); s.runtime.checkpoints.push('INTAKE_VALIDATED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json,i=s.input; if(!i.case.caseId||!i.case.incidentId||!i.case.accountKey) throw new Error('SR_CORRELATION_KEYS_MISSING'); s.runtime.caseCorrelation={caseId:i.case.caseId,incidentId:i.case.incidentId,accountKey:i.case.accountKey}; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('CASE_CORRELATED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const now=new Date(s.input.runMetadata.startedAt); const stale=s.input.evidence.filter(e=>e.freshness!=='CURRENT'||Number.isNaN(new Date(e.observedAt).getTime())||new Date(e.observedAt)>now); s.runtime.staleEvidenceIds=stale.map(e=>e.evidenceId); s.runtime.checkpoints.push('FRESHNESS_CLASSIFIED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const sys=s.input.evidence.filter(e=>e.category==='SYSTEM_HEALTH'&&e.trustStatus==='VERIFIED').map(e=>e.facts.serviceAvailable).filter(v=>typeof v==='boolean'); s.runtime.contradictoryTechnicalEvidence=(new Set(sys)).size>1; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('CONTRADICTIONS_CHECKED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const ev=s.input.evidence.filter(e=>e.category==='SYSTEM_HEALTH'&&e.trustStatus==='VERIFIED'&&e.freshness==='CURRENT').sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.observedAt)-new Date(b.observedAt)); let status='UNVERIFIED'; if(!s.runtime.contradictoryTechnicalEvidence&&ev.length){ const latest=ev[ev.length-1].facts||{}; const er=Number(latest.errorRatePct); status=latest.serviceAvailable===true&&Number.isFinite(er)&&er<=1?'RESTORED':latest.serviceAvailable===true?'PARTIALLY_RESTORED':'NOT_RESTORED'; } s.runtime.technicalStatus=status; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('TECHNICAL_STATUS_CALCULATED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const ev=s.input.evidence.filter(e=>e.category==='CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION'&&e.trustStatus==='VERIFIED'&&e.freshness==='CURRENT').sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.observedAt)-new Date(b.observedAt)); let status='INCONCLUSIVE'; if(ev.length){ const f=ev[ev.length-1].facts||{}; if(f.customerConfirmedUse===true&&f.confidenceSignal==='RESTORED') status='RESTORED'; else if(f.customerConfirmedUse===true) status='RECOVERING'; else if(f.confidenceSignal==='AT_RISK') status='AT_RISK'; } s.runtime.relationshipStatus=status; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('RELATIONSHIP_STATUS_CALCULATED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const ts=s.input.evidence.filter(e=>e.category==='INCIDENT_TIMELINE'&&e.facts&&e.facts.restoredAt).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.facts.restoredAt)-new Date(b.facts.restoredAt)); let status='UNKNOWN'; if(ts.length&&s.runtime.technicalStatus==='RESTORED'){ const restored=new Date(ts[ts.length-1].facts.restoredAt), due=new Date(s.input.case.slaRestoreBy); if(!Number.isNaN(restored.getTime())&&!Number.isNaN(due.getTime())) status=restored<=due?'MET':'BREACHED'; } s.runtime.slaStatus=status; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('SLA_CLASSIFIED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; s.runtime.aiDraft={summary:'Synthetic bounded recovery narrative.',technicalStatus:s.runtime.technicalStatus,relationshipStatus:s.runtime.relationshipStatus,evidenceRefs:s.input.evidence.map(e=>e.evidenceId),confidence:0.88}; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('AI_DRAFT_REPLAYED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json,a=s.runtime.aiDraft,c=s.runtime.aiCritique; const allowedT=['UNVERIFIED','NOT_RESTORED','PARTIALLY_RESTORED','RESTORED'],allowedR=['AT_RISK','RECOVERING','RESTORED','INCONCLUSIVE']; const evidenceIds=new Set(s.input.evidence.map(e=>e.evidenceId)); const refs=Array.isArray(a.evidenceRefs)?a.evidenceRefs:[]; const refsValid=refs.length>0&&refs.every(r=>evidenceIds.has(r)); if(!a||!c||!allowedT.includes(a.technicalStatus)||!allowedR.includes(a.relationshipStatus)||a.technicalStatus!==s.runtime.technicalStatus||a.relationshipStatus!==s.runtime.relationshipStatus||c.inventedContentFlag===true||!refsValid||typeof a.confidence!=='number'||a.confidence<0||a.confidence>1) throw new Error('SR_AI_OUTPUT_INVALID'); s.runtime.checkpoints.push('AI_OUTPUTS_VALIDATED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; let route='HUMAN_RECOVERY_PLAN'; if(s.runtime.contradictoryTechnicalEvidence) route='HUMAN_REVIEW_CONTRADICTION'; else if(s.runtime.recurrenceDetected) route='PROBLEM_MANAGEMENT'; else if(['NOT_RESTORED','PARTIALLY_RESTORED','UNVERIFIED'].includes(s.runtime.technicalStatus)) route='ESCALATE_TECHNICAL'; else if(s.runtime.relationshipStatus==='AT_RISK'||s.runtime.relationshipStatus==='INCONCLUSIVE') route='HUMAN_RECOVERY_PLAN'; else if(s.runtime.approvalValid) route='MONITOR_RECOVERY'; s.runtime.route=route; s.runtime.checkpoints.push('ROUTE_DETERMINED'); return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json; const required=['technicalStatus','relationshipStatus','slaStatus','route','approvalValid','sixSigma']; for(const k of required){if(s.runtime[k]===undefined) throw new Error('SR_ENVELOPE_FIELD_MISSING:'+k);} s.output={schemaVersion:'1.0.0',recordType:'SERVICE_RECOVERY_DECISION',syntheticData:true,runMetadata:s.input.runMetadata,case:s.input.case,technicalStatus:s.runtime.technicalStatus,relationshipStatus:s.runtime.relationshipStatus,slaStatus:s.runtime.slaStatus,recurrenceDetected:s.runtime.recurrenceDetected,route:s.runtime.route,humanApprovalValid:s.runtime.approvalValid,sixSigma:s.runtime.sixSigma,evidenceRefs:s.input.evidence.map(e=>e.evidenceId),checkpoints:s.runtime.checkpoints}; return [{json:s}];

const s=$input.first().json,o=s.output,esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c])); s.executiveHtml='VANTIX Attestor Service Recovery
SYNTHETIC DESIGN VALIDATION ONLY

VANTIX Attestor — Service Recovery

Technical
'+esc(o.technicalStatus)+'
Relationship
'+esc(o.relationshipStatus)+'
SLA
'+esc(o.slaStatus)+'
Route
'+esc(o.route)+'

Case: '+esc(o.case.caseId)+' | Correlation: '+esc(o.runMetadata.correlationId)+'

'; return [{json:s}];
